text:
mia.sales: Hey team — Aurora Dataworks wants a co-sell pilot next month. Primary asks: on-prem proxy support for data ingress, pricing for 200k tokens/day, and completion of their security questionnaire. Can we triage?

carlos.partnerops: I can be the partner PM. They want a POC env that mirrors their SOC controls (segmented tenant + audit logging). Asking if we can do a short-term on-prem proxy or relay.

dan.eng: On-prem proxy relay is doable as a temporary gateway (tls termination -> mutual TLS to our staging). Need details: allowed ports, cert format, and if they want request signing.

priya.sec: I'll handle the questionnaire. First question: do we support customer-supplied mTLS certs for ingestion? If not, do we offer customer-managed KMS for data keys?

mia.sales: They flagged mTLS + HSM for key custody as preferred. Procurement will likely make HSM a must for production, but pilot can be flexible.

dan.eng: For pilot: we can provide a lightweight proxy container that runs in their VPC and forwards to a staging tenant. It supports mutual TLS certs and request-level HMAC if they want. We'll need an infra ticket to generate the helm chart and a runbook. Example config below (fill values):

```
proxy:
  mode: relay
  listen: 0.0.0.0:443
  mTLS:
    ca_bundle: "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..."
    verify_client: true
  upstream:
    url: https://staging.redwood.example/aurora
    client_cert: "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..."
    client_key: "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----..."
  allowed_ips:
    - 10.0.0.0/22
```

carlos.partnerops: I'll ask Aurora for the CA bundle and whether they want mutual auth or token auth. Also asking for metadata: number of test users, expected QPS (they said mostly bursty).

mia.sales: Pricing ask: 200k tokens/day for two weeks. They prefer a capped pilot cost. Any quick estimate? Include option for dedicated buffer.

dan.eng: Quick back-of-envelope: hosted endpoint w/ quantized medium model ~ $0.15 per 1k tokens => 200k tokens/day = 200 * $0.15 = $30/day (note: using 1k-token units). For 14 days ~ $420. If they want a dedicated burst window with reserved nodes, add pro-rata of $1500 for 2-week reserved capacity. These are roughs; I'll refine once we pick model & batch profile.

priya.sec: Logging/retention Q: they need 180-day audit logs for pilot. Our default is 30 days. We can offer extended retention as an add-on (enterprise). I'll mark as gating if they need it as a requirement.

mia.sales: Legal question: will they accept customer-managed KMS (cloud provider) or insist on FIPS 140-2 HSM?

dan.eng: For pilot, customer-managed KMS is fine (envelope encryption). HSM-backed on-prem requires Private deployment; not feasible for a short POC. Suggest we propose a roadmap: pilot w/ customer KMS and plan for HSM in Private for production.

carlos.partnerops: Noted. I'll push that as compromise. Also they asked about telemetry hooks — can we emit per-request traces to their Splunk endpoint?

dan.eng: Yes, we can forward request-level metrics and traces to a partner endpoint over HTTPS. Need endpoint URL and auth header. We should limit PII in traces; default scrub rules apply.

infra-bot: infra-ticket created: PROV-4127 (proxy chart, staging tenant, monitoring hooks). ETA: 36h for chart, 48h for tenant.

priya.sec: Action list from my side: start questionnaire draft, attach SOC2 summary + pen test, note KMS vs HSM path, and propose 90-day retention add-on.

mia.sales: Action items: dan to post final proxy config + cost table by EOD tomorrow, carlos to collect CA bundle + telemetry endpoint + expected QPS, priya to submit questionnaire draft. I'll coordinate the partner bridge.

carlos.partnerops: Will loop Aurora and ask for certs and the legal procurement timeline. If they want HSM for production, ask for timelines — we might need sales/legal involvement early.

dan.eng: Will prepare a compact runbook for on-prem relay + sample helm values and post here. Also will include a minimal model choice (quantized Llama-variant) for cost calc.

mia.sales: Thanks all. Keep updates in-thread. If procurement escalates, I'll add legal. :white_check_mark:
